verdict.rationale: LiteLLM ships a self-hosted proxy gateway, and its docs make only latency-adjacent claims: caching can reduce latency, traffic mirroring runs in the background without affecting primary-request latency, and worker-process count is configurable for scaling. Nothing in the pack quantifies or directly documents the overhead the proxy itself adds to provider calls. missing for 10: published proxy-overhead latency benchmarks, documented performance characteristics of the gateway hop, independent or hands-on corroboration of low overhead.
